abstract: OBJECTIVE: To present and discuss our experience with cytologic study of fine needle aspiration for the diagnosis of histologically confirmed childhood teratomas/teratoid lesions and to highlight the limitations in diagnosis. STUDY DESIGN: Cases with histologic diagnosis of teratoma from the archives of the histopathology section of the Department of Pathology were identified. Only cases preceded by fine needle aspiration cytology were included in the study. RESULTS: The 11 cases of teratoma/teratoid lesions were from 4 males and 7 females. Their ages ranged from 3 months to 12 years (mean, approximately 3 years). The clinicoradiologic diagnosis varied between neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor and teratomas. The radiologic features were available in only 6 cases at the time of aspiration. Squamous cells were the main findings in cases diagnosed as teratomas. Other elements, like neuroectodermal cells and mesodermal derivatives like muscle, adipose tissue and columnar cells, were also seen. Immature mesenchymal fragments were recognized in 2 cases. CONCLUSION: Clinical details and radiologic investigations are crucial to the cytologic diagnosis of teratomas, differentiating them from the other common childhood tumors.
abstract_ja: 目的：小児の奇形腫/奇形腫様病変について、組織学的に確定した症例の穿刺吸引細胞診所見を検討し、診断上の限界を明らかにすること。研究デザイン：病理部の保管症例から奇形腫の組織診断が得られた症例を抽出した。組織診断に先立って穿刺吸引細胞診が行われた症例のみを対象とした。結果：奇形腫/奇形腫様病変11例（男児4例、女児7例）。年齢は3か月～12歳（平均約3歳）。臨床・画像診断は神経芽細胞腫、Wilms腫瘍、奇形腫のいずれかであった。画像所見は穿刺時に6例でのみ利用可能だった。奇形腫と診断された症例では扁平上皮細胞が主要な所見であった。神経外胚葉成分や、筋肉・脂肪組織・円柱上皮などの中胚葉由来成分も認められた。未熟な間葉成分の断片が2例で認められた。結論：奇形腫の細胞診断には臨床情報と画像検査が不可欠であり、他の小児腫瘍との鑑別に重要である。
